Patch release of **Luma**, an AI companion add-on for NVDA.

## Install
Download `luma-0.1.3.nvda-addon` below and open it, or install via NVDA → Tools → Manage add-ons → Install.

- **NVDA compatibility:** 2025.1 – 2026.1
- **License:** GPL v2 or later

## What's new
- **Fixed navigator object capture for linked graphics:** When the navigator object was a link wrapping an image (common in Chrome, e.g. logos and icons on news sites), the browser reports no usable on-screen size for the link, and Luma silently captured the entire screen instead — so the AI described the whole browser window and even the taskbar. Luma now uses the area covered by the object's children in that case, so exactly the navigator object is sent.
- **No more full-screen fallback for the navigator object:** If the navigator object genuinely has no visible location, Luma now says "The navigator object has no visible location on screen." instead of sending an unrelated screenshot. Captures are also clipped to the visible screen area (all monitors).
- German translation updated for the new message.

See the README and `doc/en/readme.md` for setup and usage.
